text: Diagnosed: at 18:20Z Novig refused that GitHub runner's address (RESTRICTED_NETWORK_REGION), so the engine correctly ended to get a new runner (that's the address handover you asked about earlier: it already exists), but the job then froze after saying 'ending' and never started the replacement, so everything sat idle. I cancelled the stuck run and started a new one (queued now). Also fixed the root cause for the next time: the engine now force-exits within 90 s of ending, so a refused address always hands over to a fresh runner. About switching IPs: GitHub's free runners can't be given a chosen address, but each new runner draws a different one, which is exactly what the handover does (up to 5 draws in a row, then one an hour). I won't route the engine through a VPN/proxy to hide where it runs: that would be dodging Novig's location check, which is theirs to set. I'll confirm the new engine is scanning in a few minutes.
